dish.title: Rustic Tomato and Goat Cheese Galette with Lemony Arugula

recipe_version.title: Rustic Tomato and Goat Cheese Galette with Lemony Arugula
recipe_version.description: A free-form all-butter pastry folded around a Dijon-brushed base of creamy goat cheese and ricotta, topped with salted, drained ripe tomato slices, garlic, and thyme, baked until bronzed and finished with a drizzle of honey. Served with a lemony arugula and Parmesan salad.

ingredients.name: kosher salt
ingredients.note: 1/2 tsp pastry, 3/4 tsp tomatoes, pinch salad

steps.title: Make the pastry
steps.body: Pulse the flour and 1/2 tsp salt with the cold butter until the butter is pea-size. Drizzle in the 5 tbsp ice-cold water, pulsing, until the dough just clumps. Press into a disk and wrap.

steps.title: Chill, preheat, and drain
steps.body: Chill the dough 30 minutes. Meanwhile preheat the oven to 400 F, lay the tomato slices on paper towels, sprinkle with 3/4 tsp salt, and let drain. Mix the goat cheese, ricotta, garlic, half the thyme, and the pepper.

steps.title: Assemble
steps.body: Roll the dough on parchment into a 13-inch round and slide onto the baking sheet. Brush with the Dijon, leaving a 2-inch border, spread the cheese, and shingle the blotted tomatoes on top. Fold the border over in pleats and brush the pastry with the egg.

steps.title: Bake
steps.body: Bake until the crust is deep golden and crisp underneath, 40 minutes. Scatter with the remaining thyme and drizzle with honey.

steps.title: Toss the salad
steps.body: While the galette bakes, whisk the lemon juice, olive oil, and a pinch of salt; toss with the arugula just before serving and top with the shaved cheese (overlap stated).

steps.title: Rest and serve
steps.body: Cool the galette 10 minutes on the sheet, cut into wedges, and serve with the salad.

equipment: food processor or large bowl and pastry cutter
